Author: Martz
Name: Qiqirn Companion
Description: Browse open FC craft projects and claim tasks directly from inside the game. Trading queries, item search, and craft-from-inventory with live Marketboard prices.
Punchline: In-game FC project tracker, trading scanner, and craft helper.
Changelog: Added a hidden helper for the guild's weekly Ruleta del Estilismo: open it with /qiqirn ruleta, type a name and how many haircuts the person has, and hit Daleee to roll a random haircut plus base-color and highlight grid positions. Copy the result to paste into chat.
